method: Two subscriptions on an All Apps organization bound to the Orchestrator's stock payload-dumping workflow, then one create and one delete of a three-machine template, with every payload read out of the workflow run logs. No host name, identifier or credential is recorded here.

bindingForms.result: 201, both fields silently dropped, dispatches nothing

bindingForms.form: type RUNNABLE + runnableType + runnableId + subscriberId naming the service identity
bindingForms.result: the working record, as made by the console

blockingGate.scopedBy: a criteria expression on the template id, so nothing else in the organization was gated

allow.note: one run per resource, every one completed, and the deployment proceeded

block.note: the delete stopped at the first refused resource rather than attempting all eight, and every resource was left in place

recover.note: the identical delete succeeded once the gate could complete; no other change

blockingGate.operatorMessage: the failed request names the subscriber, the runnable, the subscription and the workflow run id, then quotes the workflow's own error

timeoutAttempt.built: a workflow taking one inputProperties input whose only task sleeps 600 seconds
timeoutAttempt.outcome: the gate never fired: zero workflow executions, the deployment proceeded past it
timeoutAttempt.cause: runnableId is resolved by the Orchestrator Gateway API on the Automation node, not by the appliance holding the workflow. The workflow answered 200 on the appliance and 404 on the gateway, so the subscription pointed at an identifier the dispatch plane could not resolve
timeoutAttempt.lesson: verify a workflow through the Automation host's gateway before binding a subscription to it; reading it back from the Orchestrator proves it exists and proves nothing about whether an event can reach it

reread.note: read-only: the topic catalog, every subscription in the organization, and the dispatch plane's answer for one stock workflow and one id that does not exist

missingTopicProbe.what: one subscription, disabled and non-blocking, on a topic this organization does not publish; read back, audited, deleted

output: CANNOT DISPATCH pca probe: topic not published           compute.removal.pre                disabled
- its topic is not published in this organization, so it never fires
- no runnable is bound, so it dispatches nothing
1 of 1 cannot dispatch, 0 cannot hold the operation they block; the platform reports none of them as an error

deleteGate.what: gate.py imported as a workflow by deploy_gate.py, bound by a blocking subscription scoped by criteria to one template resource name, then four throwaway deployments of one ConfigMap created and deleted through it; the subscription, workflow, category and deployments removed and the residue read

registries.refuse: an address in a documentation range that no host answers
registries.pass: a path that answers 404, as a registry holding no record does

auditOnStringConstraint.line: its project constraint is a string, not a list of project ids, so it matches no event and never fires

create.log: CREATE_RESOURCE on <resource>: not a delete, nothing to do

refuse.raised: the de-registration did not finish inside 20 s (2 attempt(s), last: URLError: timed out); refusing the delete

pass.log: already absent (HTTP 404), counted as done after 1 attempt(s) in 0.0 s; the delete may continue

deleteGate.notExercised: the subscription timeout (the gate ran with timeout 0 and bounded itself), a registry answering 2xx, and the resource kind lookup
